notes.title: Post-launch update
notes.content:
[p]Hey emperors of Proelium!  As is often the case, a few smaller issues were found after launch. Several of those issues have been fixed. If any other issues are found, future updates may come out as well. Thanks for reporting things to me, it helps. ːReeneOKː[/p][p][/p][h3]The following things have changed: 
[/h3][p] - Cooked food is no longer worth anything to an NPC to fix a money exploit. Uncooked food can still be bought and sold.  [/p][p]- Fixed a few typos.  [/p][p]- Fixed Yoni not having an opinion of Serenity Island.  [/p][p]- The demon down at Snowfox prison did not disappear after finishing her quest and could softlock players that talked to her again. She should now disappear after the quest is concluded.  [/p][p]- To avoid confusion at Sodalitas Island, if player's try to use a ship that does not belong to them, Letha will make a comment saying it's not your ship. [/p][p]- Fixed an issue with a letter showing the wrong text when read. [/p][p]- A few other minor tweaks.[/p][p][/p][p]There are a few things that are tough to improve due to the engine's jankiness, but I will try to improve the game to the best of my abilities if more issues show up in the future. Thanks![/p]

notes.title: Remaster is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1][p][/p][p]The remaster is finally complete! With reservations for potential glitch patching in the future, but it's otherwise fully complete now.

Thanks to the support from everyone that bought the original game! Your feedback helped me make this remaster possible.

The remaster comes with new content such as:

- Gothfair and Snowfox Valley expanded a little
- Several new islands to explore
- A new treasure map quest, a love trail quest (requires Letha and Yoni to be married), and more
- Defend the fortress mission added to the Port Commercia fortress after Cupide has been defeated

The remaster also includes:

- Improved turn-based combat system, now more standard rather than the basic engine system

- Overhaul of many skills, including Letha and Yoni each having one ultimate skill each. The ultimate skills and some other skills are stronger than before, but now requires some stamina to activate

- A nemesis-ish system including random events (selected at random at the start of a new playthrough), options to kill or spare other masters and consequences, both positive and negative, from such choices

- Some new weapons and ship skins you can select (talk to Samuel to see the list of skins)


Other improvements:

- More visually appealing UI and text font
- Character images for Letha and Yoni used more often and now look a bit sharper than in the original
- Some minor glitches and typos fixed
- While Yoni is in the party, press Q to open a social menu. You can ask for her opinion about the map you are currently in, or select random chatter to get a random dialogue between Letha and Yoni


It would be super appreciated if you would like to leave feedback if you find something I missed to fix during testing. And it would also mean a lot to see reviews for the remaster. Thanks! ːReeneOKː[/p]

notes.title: Update New Locations
notes.content:
[h3]Hey emperors![/h3]

Trials of Proelium Remastered is getting some new content!
In the last update, I went over the new social menu. Being able to socialize more with Yoni and stuff like that.

In this update I would like to share some news regarding content in the remaster.

[h2]New locations:[/h2]

- Gothfair district has been slightly expanded and now features a semi-hidden area. At this area, a fighting club resides. Summons are not going to be used in the remaster, both so the UI takes up less space on screen, but also to make the game a bit more challenging. However, you can still let your trustworthy companion Mittens fight in the fighting pits to earn rewards for you.

- Underneath the church at Snowfox Valley, a new prison exists. Inside this prison is a character you may recognize if you played other games of mine.

- Sodalitas Island. A new couples resort where Letha and Yoni can relax. If they are married, there's also a new love trail quest they can do at this island to strengthen their relationship.

- Serenity Island. A small island with some crafting materials. Is also used for a certain event.

- Proelium's Border. Right at the edge of Proelium in the north is a new island. Proelium's community association can be found here and a treasure hunt quest can start here.

- Skull Island. A new island with a cave in the shape of a skull Letha and Yoni can explore.


[h2]Other news:[/h2]

I'm getting closer and closer to the testing phase. Soon I will play through the game and start fixing potential bugs and other stuff. If all goes smoothly, the remaster will most likely come out this month. If not, then sometime later this summer.

notes.title: Relationship update
notes.content:
[h1]Hey emperors![/h1]

Trials of Proelium Remastered is going to come out summer of this year, so in the not so distant future.
A lot of focus lately has been to make Letha and Yoni's relationship deeper with more interactions. I've also been busy with minor fixes and improvements in the levels and doing an overhaul of the different skill trees for both characters.

[h2]Improvements to their relationship:[/h2]

A social menu has been added to the game. It can be accessed at any time outside of combat and cutscenes while both Letha and Yoni are in the party. In the menu, you can pick "Opinion about the area we're at", which will make Yoni share her opinion and thoughts about the map you're currently at, and "Random chatter" which is exactly what it sounds like, Letha and Yoni will talk about something random. A story from their past, "would you rather" questions, talking about their favorite foods and much more. In some cases, asking Yoni about her opinion can lead to discussions with choices. The choices being a neutral but friendly response, or a more flirty response depending on if you prefer them being friends or more than that.

There will be a demo coming out in the near future as well. ːReeneOKː

More updates later. Have a good one!
